known_limitations: The stream is a read-only local artifact aggregator and intentionally does not create or subscribe to a separate event bus.
Quiet live updates are represented through regenerated local JSON and the existing Operations Center quiet refresh path.
Future dockable bottom-panel work can consume the structured stream payload and filters directly.
summary: Implemented a read-only Operator Activity Stream that aggregates Mission Control, worker runtime, validation, notification, mailbox, service health, work package, and completion artifacts into a filterable, verbosity-aware event feed with source links and Operations Center integration.
